decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche defence product that is only mentioned on the website, which signals weak commitment, but a large firm has enough slack to carry it while long naval procurement cycles play out.

The medical examination light has its own product page and fits an established, stable market for professional lighting, so there is no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires carry certification investments and serve a steady industrial demand, so the firm is likely to carry them at least until results become clearer.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product with proven demand and a dedicated page, so its performance likely meets aspiration levels based on past results.
